item.title: Wellstar West Georgia Medical Center Earns Multiple National Awards from Healthgrades
item.description: Wellstar West Georgia Medical Center has been recognized among the nation’s best hospitals, earning a series of awards from Healthgrades that reflect excellence in safety, clinical outcomes, patient experience, and specialty care. Healthgrades, a leading resource for information about physicians and hospitals, honored the medical center with several top distinctions in 2025 and 2026, placing Wellstar West Georgia among the top-performing hospitals in the country. item.title: Byers builds confidence from the start
item.description: From paraprofessional to Teacher of the Year, Rosemont Elementary’s Jenna Byers builds young students’ confidence through creative lessons, schoolwide broadcasts and a focus on resilience.

item.title: Troup girls soccer is looking for a breakthrough 2026 season

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - L. Michelle Moore: Mutual Aid
item.description: Mutual aid among utilities is a longstanding and powerful tradition, and the crews and individual lineworkers who roll trucks in the most extreme weather to get the power back on are everyday heroes. item.title: LaGrange Community Band seeking new members
item.description: LaGrange Community Band invites musicians of all skill levels, no auditions required, to rehearse Tuesdays at First Baptist as they prepare a free April 21 concert.

item.title: Riverkeeper talks efforts to keep the Chattahoochee clean
item.description: Chattahoochee Riverkeeper outlines how lawsuits, constant water testing and volunteer cleanups have left the river cleaner today than in the 1960s despite Atlanta’s growth.

item.title: The Troup boys soccer team is looking to make it back to the playoffs
